scope: Fresh Linux x86_64 measurement of the CEO 60-second goal (Mandate item 10) on the CEO's CachyOS laptop, using the T-CLAUDE-STEP1LINUX-1 method. Debug development instance only. Not release qualification, not a full gate, not production promotion.

source.relation: measured tree == origin/main (clean worktree; loop edits applied and reverted in the working tree, never committed)

host.kind: physical laptop shared with other active agents (Claude, Codex, other SUSI workers); 1-minute load average 5-22 during measurement; wall-clock numbers include that contention
host.isolation: private worktree /mnt/shared/src/github.com/intellibitz/susi-agent-grok-step1linux2; fresh empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR /mnt/shared/tmp/grok-step1linux2-target; private HOME, SUSI_HOME, XDG_* and TMPDIR under /tmp/grok-step1linux2; scrubbed tokens/proxies; SUSI_PORT_OFFSET=1700 (10790-10794), verified free before start and released after

cold_debug.precondition: empty private target; registry sources already in the Cargo home; default features

build.warm_noop_note: first no-op 3.5 s includes cargo re-checking fingerprints right after the cold build; steady state ~0.2 s

first_run.note: includes first compile of the susi-daemon test profile

startup.not_measured: goal acknowledgment, first useful model output and goal completion (default build has no local engine)

delivery_loop.change: crates/susi-daemon/src/server.rs host-contract report gains a 'Health http://127.0.0.1:<gmcp>/health' line plus a test assertion (same change as the Nov 6 record); alternately applied with git apply and reverted with git checkout in the working tree. Not committed.
delivery_loop.steps: edit -> cargo build -p susi --bin susi -> cargo fmt --all --check + cargo test -p susi-daemon --lib host_contract (2 tests) -> susi restart (offset 1700) -> /health 200 -> susi start output shows/hides the line AND /proc/<daemon pid>/exe sha256 equals the rebuilt binary
delivery_loop.rollback: each revert rep restores prior behaviour on the live daemon; reverted exe is byte-identical to the cold build (db5fdfeb...), apply builds identical to each other (e9276743...)
delivery_loop.under_60_s: yes for this inner loop: all 6 reps 13.3-37.6 s, median 13.9 s; rep 6 (37.6 s) coincided with another agent's load spike (1-min load 6.7 -> 22.2)
delivery_loop.difference_from_nov6: Nov 6 included a git commit step (106-188 ms) per rep; this run edits the working tree only (4-53 ms) per the brief. Otherwise identical steps.

publish_step.note: Publishing this record to development main via local-snapshot submit is timed separately and reported in the task handoff; it is not part of the inner loop above.

comparison_with_T-CLAUDE-STEP1LINUX-1_20.host_difference: Nov 6 ran in a 4-CPU/15 GiB cloud container on source 784518e4 (0.21.51); this run is the 28-CPU/219 GiB CachyOS laptop on de22ea776 (0.21.53) with -j 8 under load 5-22. Numbers are comparable in method, not in hardware.

mandate_10_verdict: The inner change-to-useful-result loop for a one-file core change is under 60 s on this host today (median 13.9 s, worst 37.6 s under a load spike). The full mandate loop through publication to main, distillation, release qualification and promotion to a verified live executable was NOT measured and is not claimed. Warm start-to-healthy regressed ~2x vs Nov 6 (271-285 ms vs 144-145 ms) and stop is ~40% slower; cause not investigated (different host, load, 2 releases of changes).

issues_found.summary: `susi tasks claim` (installed 0.21.20) failed again with 'claimed concurrently' after 58 s; same root cause as recorded in .agents/evidence/publisher-linux-T-GROKPUBLINUX-1.json (push-policy rejects refs/claim-generation/current). Not bypassed; task proceeded unclaimed on two exact files.
warm start-to-health 271-285 ms and stop 409-426 ms vs 144-145 / 291-301 ms on Nov 6; not root-caused; may be host/load or code change.

limitations: Heavy, variable host load from other agents (1-min load 5-22); rep 6 shows its effect.
Debug build, default features (no local engine); no model output measured.
Only 2 focused tests in the loop; local-workflow affected selection and full gate not run.
No optimized/production build, qualification, promotion or rollback of an installed release.
Different hardware from the Nov 6 record.

provenance.produced_by: Grok Bot executor on the CEO's CachyOS laptop
